"""Frozen close-time engulfing hypothesis; no execution or economic evidence."""

import pandas as pd

from quant_lab.config import StrictModel
from quant_lab.strategies.base import BaseStrategy


class Parameters(StrictModel):
    """No adjustable parameters in this frozen hypothesis."""


class ManualEngulfingBreakoutV1Strategy(BaseStrategy[Parameters]):
    name = "manual_engulfing_breakout_v1"
    version = "1.0.0"
    description = "Bullish close above the contiguous previous bearish candle high"
    status = "research"
    created_at = "2026-11-03T08:00:00+00:00"
    lab_timeframes = ("1h",)
    lab_modes = ("LONG_ONLY",)
    lab_execution = "ohlcv"
    parameter_model = Parameters

    @classmethod
    def required_warmup(cls, parameters: dict, timeframe: str) -> int:
        return 100

    def prepare_features(self, candles: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        result = candles.copy()
        result["previous_high"] = candles.high.shift(1)
        result["previous_low"] = candles.low.shift(1)
        result["previous_bearish"] = candles.close.shift(1) < candles.open.shift(1)
        result["valid_previous"] = candles.timestamp.diff() == pd.Timedelta(hours=1)
        result["ready"] = [i >= 100 for i in range(len(candles))]
        return result

    def generate_long_entries(self, f) -> list[bool]:
        return (
            (
                f.ready
                & f.valid_previous
                & f.previous_bearish
                & (f.close > f.open)
                & (f.close > f.previous_high)
            )
            .fillna(False)
            .tolist()
        )

    def generate_long_exits(self, f) -> list[bool]:
        return (f.ready & f.valid_previous & (f.close < f.previous_low)).fillna(False).tolist()

    def generate_short_entries(self, features) -> list[bool]:
        return [False] * len(features)

    def generate_short_exits(self, features) -> list[bool]:
        return [False] * len(features)
